raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fixes #57503.

Some quantized layers retain a `weight` attribute whose value is `None` after moving the usable weight to `weight_packed` or `qweight`. `_get_lora_device` currently checks only whether each attribute exists, so LoRA wrapper creation can fail with an `AttributeError` instead of continuing to the usable weight.

This change treats `None` weights as unavailable while preserving the existing candidate order. It also adds a regression test covering multiple `None` candidates followed by a valid quantized weight.

A duplicate-work check found no active, mergeable PR providing this focused fix and regression coverage.

AI assistance was used to analyze the downstream change, implement the patch, and run validation. The submitter reviewed the resulting changes.

## Test Plan

- Run the focused LoRA device-detection tests.
- Run the broader LoRA layer test suite.
- Serve a compressed-tensors W4A8 model with LoRA enabled on two Intel XPUs and send an OpenAI-compatible completion request.
- Run pre-commit checks for the changed files.

## Test Result

- Before the fix, the regression test failed with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'device'`.
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/lora/test_layers_utils.py -q`: `5 passed, 16 warnings in 0.74s`.
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/lora/test_layers.py -q`: `164 passed, 144 skipped, 16 warnings in 80.16s`.
- `pre-commit run --files vllm/lora/layers/utils.py tests/lora/test_layers_utils.py`: passed.
- Full E2E on two Intel Arc Pro B70 devices, using a local compressed-tensors W4A8 INT export of the official `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B` checkpoint loaded as `Qwen3_5ForCausalLM`:

```bash
source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn

.venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model /llm/models/Qwen3.5-9B-Text-W4A8-Dynamic-Per-Token \
  --served-model-name qwen3.5-9b-w4a8 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 18080 \
  --dtype float16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --block-size 64 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.70 \
  --max-model-len 512 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 512 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --enable-lora \
  --max-loras 1 \
  --max-lora-rank 8
```

The export uses INT4 symmetric group-128 weights and dynamic per-token INT8 activations. The server selected `CompressedTensorsW4A8Int` with `XPUW4A8IntLinearKernel` and reached `Application startup complete`.

```bash
curl -sS --fail-with-body http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"qwen3.5-9b-w4a8","prompt":"The capital of France is","max_tokens":8,"temperature":0}'
```

The request returned HTTP 200 and generated `" Paris. This is a well-established fact"`. At the parent commit, the identical server configuration failed deterministically during LoRA wrapper creation at `_get_lora_device` with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'device'`.

- `pre-commit run --all-files`: changed-code checks passed. The full-tree run additionally regenerated the unrelated ROCm test lock file under the local XPU resolver and failed the unrelated non-root entrypoint case 3; the generated lock-file change was discarded.

---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR is described.
- [x] The test plan is included.
- [x] Test results, including before/after behavior, are included.
- [x] No documentation update is required for this internal correctness fix.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,19 @@ def test_get_lora_device_unquantized():
     assert _get_lora_device(base_layer) == base_layer.weight.device
 
 
+def test_get_lora_device_skips_none_weights():
+    base_layer = nn.Module()
+    base_layer.weight = None
+    base_layer.weight_packed = None
+    base_layer.qweight = None
+    base_layer.ark_linear = nn.Module()
+    base_layer.ark_linear.qweight = None
+    base_layer.w2_weight = None
+    base_layer.w2_weight_packed = None
+    base_layer.w2_qweight = _param()
+    assert _get_lora_device(base_layer) == base_layer.w2_qweight.device
+
+
 def test_get_lora_device_gptq_awq():
     base_layer = nn.Module()
     base_layer.qweight = _param()

@@ -49,26 +49,30 @@ def _get_lora_device(base_layer: nn.Module) -> torch.device:
         base_layer = base_layer.routed_experts
 
     # unquantizedLinear
-    if hasattr(base_layer, "weight"):
-        return base_layer.weight.device
+    if (weight := getattr(base_layer, "weight", None)) is not None:
+        return weight.device
     # Compressed Tensor
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "weight_packed"):
-        return base_layer.weight_packed.device
+    elif (weight_packed := getattr(base_layer, "weight_packed", None)) is not None:
+        return weight_packed.device
     # GPTQ/AWQ
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "qweight"):
-        return base_layer.qweight.device
+    elif (qweight := getattr(base_layer, "qweight", None)) is not None:
+        return qweight.device
     # INC WNA16 (AutoRound)
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "ark_linear"):
-        return base_layer.ark_linear.qweight.device
+    elif (ark_linear := getattr(base_layer, "ark_linear", None)) is not None and (
+        ark_qweight := getattr(ark_linear, "qweight", None)
+    ) is not None:
+        return ark_qweight.device
     # MoE layer
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "w2_weight"):
-        return base_layer.w2_weight.device
+    elif (w2_weight := getattr(base_layer, "w2_weight", None)) is not None:
+        return w2_weight.device
     # MoE Compressed Tensor
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "w2_weight_packed"):
-        return base_layer.w2_weight_packed.device
+    elif (
+        w2_weight_packed := getattr(base_layer, "w2_weight_packed", None)
+    ) is not None:
+        return w2_weight_packed.device
     # MoE GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF
-    elif hasattr(base_layer, "w2_qweight"):
-        return base_layer.w2_qweight.device
+    elif (w2_qweight := getattr(base_layer, "w2_qweight", None)) is not None:
+        return w2_qweight.device
     else:
         raise ValueError(f"Unsupported base layer: {base_layer}")
